# Tables inside list items

A table indented under a list item belongs to that item, after a
continuation paragraph and before the next one.

- tea, 2025Q3 (batch 410) -> 2025Q4 (433), main blend, shops in both
  surveys, median change:

  | Blend | price_per_kg | Survey B |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | Assam 2 | -0.06% | +0.49% |
  | Darjeeling 5 | +0.85% | +0.34% |
  | Ceylon 6 | -0.06% | +0.26% |
  | Oolong 7 | -0.01% | +0.47% |

  Only the first survey counts **samples**; see [notes](#notes).

- A second item with a table straight after its text:

  | Left | Right |
  |:--|--:|
  | `code` | 1 |

1. Numbered items take tables too:

   | A | B |
   |---|---|
   | x | y |

> A quote between lists.

| Top level | Still works |
|---|---|
| yes | yes |
